citation_validation.answer:
The experiments use two datasets: AliMe and Quora [1][2].

The AliMe dataset is collected from the AliMe intelligent assistant system in E-commerce, comprising 8,004 query-bag pairs, with negative bags retrieved via Lucene; it yields 12,008 training, 2,000 valid, and 10,000 test cases [1][7]. The Quora dataset is originally released for duplicated question detection, containing 400,000 question pairs; one question in a bag is extracted as query and the others form the bag, resulting in 20,354 training, 2,000 validation, and 10,000 test cases [7][8].

cited_sources.text: 3 EXPERIMENTS 3.1 Dataset We conduct experiments on two datasets: AliMe and Quora. The Al- iMe dataset is collected from the AliMe intelligent assistant system and the Quora dataset is composed of a public dataset. AliMe For the AliMe service in E-commerce, we collect 8,004 query-bag pairs to form our dataset. Negative sampling is also an important part of the matching model. For each query, we use the Lucene2 to retrieval the top-20 most similar questions from the whole question candidates.

In addition to the mutual coverage, a bag representa- tion in word level is issued to help discover the main points of a bag. The bag representation then provides new matching evidence to the query-bag matching model. We conduct experiments on the AliMe and Quora dataset for the query-bag matching based information-seeking conversation. Compared with baselines, we verify the effectiveness of our model.

Finally, we get 12,008 training cases, 2,000 valid cases, and 10,000 test cases. Please notice, for the testing, we sampled 2http://lucene.apache.org 9 negative bags instead of 1, and thus formed 10 candidates for ranking. Quora The Quora dataset is originally released for the duplicated question detection task3. The dataset contains 400,000 question pairs and each pair is marked whether they are asking the same question.

We then extract one question in the bag as query and the other questions make up the bag in our task. Considering the negative samples, we follow the same strategy as AliMe dataset. Finally, we get 20,354 training set, 2,000 validation set, and 10,000 test set. To facilitate the research in this area, the composed Quora dataset are released4. 3.2 Setup (5) We use the Adam optimizer with learning rate 0.0001 to optimize the parameters.
